question: Can the 1950-01-29 Deng Zhicheng diary route be upgraded beyond a generic later quotation without treating any edited transcription, institutional retelling, or non-target page citation as the target facsimile handwriting?
answer: Yes, at the editorial-route level only. Deng Rui states in a Nanjing University article that while 《五石斋文史札记》 was serialised in 《中国典籍与文化》, she checked every proof against the original source. A Tsinghua Alumni Association article independently preserves the 1950-01-29 purchase quotation while citing the 2012 Deng Rui-edited 《邓之诚文史札记》. Separately, a page-specific scholarly citation for a different diary passage states that the 2012 edited text is abridged and points to the 2007 facsimile volume 5 page 222. These controls establish an editor-checked transcription route and a useful non-target pagination anchor, but they do not resolve the target 1950-01-29 serial page, facsimile page, or handwriting text. No item-level transaction route for historical 3482/3483 is selected.
